KISHORE M PRODUCT SPECIALIST/ BUSINESS ANALYST Business Analysis| Product Management

Phone: 8897009749 Email: kishore.Mogali@gmail.com

Passionate, value-driven Product Management Professional with 16+ years of onsite & offshore experience leading cross-functional teamsvarious global locations of North America, APAC and EMEA. Blend domain knowledge, technology skills with extensive Agile/Scrum experience.Presently working at Synechron Technologies as Manager- Product Management – Exposure in Investment Banking, Regulatory Reporting, Data Goveranance, OTC, Market Data and Asset Management.

S I G N A T U R E S K I L L S

Key Skills

~ Equities/Derivatives/Fixed Income/OTC ~ SQL/Oracle/ Unix ~ FIX Protocol/Exchange Connectivity ~ Process Optimization ~ Stakeholder Management ~ Technology/Ops Transformation ~ Jira/Visio/HP-Quality Center ~ Test Strategy/Plan/UAT~ FIXML/FPML/JSON

~ Risk Management ~ Legacy Modernization~ Fidessa/Calypso/Murex Systems ~ Tableau/Axiom/Veritas ~ People / Team Management

~ OMS/ECN’s/Bloombeg

Certifications

Certified Agile Product Owner FRM (Financial Risk Manager) GARP - USA Level 1 NCFM Certification (Capital, Derivatives, FX, MF, Commodity market) DTCC Learning courses – Asset servicing, Risk Mgmt., Margin

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESHANDLED PRODUCT MANAGEMENT | BUSINESS ANALYST LEADER

Roadmap Planning Define product roadmaps, requirements, work closely with platform development and UX to drive sprint planning, story prioritization and manage product portfolio backlog. Ensure consistent execution of product lifecycle processes from concept to launch.

Communication: Liaise between engineering, QA, data governance, infrastructure, business owners to ensure clear communication, understanding of upcoming tasks during the sprint planning, Provide visibility of risk/issues/ burndown charts to leadership teams in Steering committee meetings

Requirements Definition: Develop comprehensive product incorporating market/client requirements. Produce backlog, requirements documents, wireframes, and business solution documents and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each release to deliver key capabilities on time. Write user stories to communicate customer needs. Secure internal and external stakeholder buy-in on both functional and non-functional requirements. Manage product enhancements (features, functionalities, and microservices) through the development of lifecycle working within waterfall and agile frameworks

BRIEF EMPLOYMENT SUMMARY

Synechron Technology Manager– Product Management| 2019-2025

Client: Lloyds Bank - UK

KEY FOCUS: | Business Analysis |MX.3 | MXML| | Trade Capture | Trade Booking TEAM SIZE: 5 members comprising BA/QA

Project Brief: Worked as a business analyst within the Front office trading transformation program supporting the MX.3 platform. Collaborated with Front office traders, product owners, Risk teams, Market data teams and technology teams to support trade lifecycle management, market data processing, pricing, valuation, and regulatory reporting initiatives across FX and interest rate products.

Kishore, Page 2 of 2 Conducted requirement gathering workshops with front office stakeholders, traders, risk managers, and operations teams to understand business needs and translate them into functional requirements. Configured trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, valiation, confirmation, settlement, and reporting. Supported Murex MX3 front office initiatives involving FX spot, FX Forward, FX swap, IRS and fixed income products.

▪

▪ ▪ ▪ Worked closely with market data teams to analyze and validate FX rates, volatility surfaces, and pricing environments used for trade

▪ ▪

valuation. Supported Front office operations team during UAT by creating scenarios and executing test cases. Supported production releases and post-implementation activities, including incident management and stakeholder communication.

KEY FOCUS: Product Management | Business Analysis |MUREX | FIXML| FPML | Calypso| Fedissa| Bloomberg | IDC | Reuters Functional Area:Front Office Order Management | Buy-Side | Reference Data Management |FIX Connectivity | Account Ref Data | Reporting | Middle office | TEAM SIZE: 18 members comprising BA/QA/Dev

Project Brief:

CITY Bank Deal Manager is a Global Derivative trading platform for Middle office teams which does creating the deals, data mastering for reference data, Data transformation based on client requirement. Deal Manager has an integrated Operational control framework consumes trade deals from different Order management systems.

Deal Manageris Integrated Front to back platform that manages different upstream and down stream application to complete investment lifecycle having Front office, Middle office and Back office management. ▪

Leading 4 product specialist comprising activities like risk identification, involved in preparing questionnaires, process flow diagrams, & enterprise analysis to future business cases. Solely accountable for planning & day-to-day operations for smooth operations of the technology and business teams. Involved in conducting user interviews/requirement workshops to gather requirements and breaking the requirements into EPICS and user stories, Prioritize stories, release planning, client demos and facilitate UAT and prod migration Prioritize the defects, enhancement, and change requests by managing the product backlogs; participate in the UAT phase by conducting functional testing, tracking issues and bug fixes to ensure smooth client onboarding and data migration, ensure SLAs are met, and develop opportunities to increase overall client satisfaction levels Facilitate as-is analysis of the client current systems, transactional data analysis and interpretation of code and querying the database to ensure there is no lack of available documentation.

▪ ▪

▪

▪

L&T Infotech | Sr. Consultant - 2017 - 2019 KEY FOCUS: Product Management | Business Analysis| Legacy Modernization| Regulatory Initiatives | Technology and Operational Transformation | New Product Development | Process Re-engineering Functional Area:Order Management | Security Reference Data Management |Master Agreement Systems| Middle Office | OTC| Account reference data | Reporting TEAM SIZE:12 members comprising BA/QA&UI/UX

▪

▪ ▪ ▪

Receive, validate, and document business requirements to determine build specifications, support testing, and support validation of test results. Also define and document exit criteria from build and test phases Actively managed the global stakeholders on delivery expectations Assisted in creating the User Interface Specification, prototype and wireframes for the new system UI. Elicit Requirements for the 21 product classes (Bond, CDS, Equity Synthetic, Swaption, Index Option, Bond Option, FX Option, Commodity Option, FX Forwards, TRS, Rate Lock, Swaps, Exotics) and migrated to the Web Oayasys System.

▪ Gathered requirements and validated for the OTC Product Class templates in CITITML formats from MXML, FIXML, FPML and XDS Formats. ▪ Worked with product manager, involved in creating user stories, High level FRD, creating wireframes, client demos, product validation and

▪

managing end to end product development, product roll out in over 4 geographical regions. Product handled trade blocking, allocations, fees, commission calculation, and trade matching systems

BNP Paribas | Sr. Consultant (On PayrollInfrasoft Technologies) 2013 – 2017 KEY FOCUS: Business Analysis| FIX Stimulations| Fedissa Order Management System | Front Office Operational Transformation | New Product Development | ECN’s – ARCA, Bloomberg, Millinium Functional Area:Order Management | FIX 4.2 | Cash equities| Order types| FIX Log Validations | FIX Connectivity | Order Routing TEAM SIZE:12 members comprising BA/QA&DEV

▪

Facilitating the scrum ceremonies like product backlog sessions, spintplanning,daily scrum, sprint retrospective and estimation for the next quarter.

▪

▪ ▪ ▪

Kishore, Page 2 of 2 Application ownership taking the responsibilities of application, Interaction with Ops groups conducting questioneries for better user satisfaction and also point of contact of functional part of the application Conducted stakeholder joint application design (JAD) interviews and facilitated meetings with project teams. Developing PRD ( Product Required Document ) and product plan for internal stakeholders, Version Updates and requirement prioritizations. Validating the FIX logs for the various issues like order routing, order rejects reason, order execution, Partial and full fill of order, session rejects and Business rejects for the orders.

Saxo Bank| Functional Consultant 2011 – 2012 KEY FOCUS: Business Analysis| FXFront Office Trading Platform| Forex OTC | DMA | Liquidity Providers Functional Area:Order Management | Spot,Forward,Options | Exotic Options like No-Touch,One-Touch,Knock in and Knock out TEAM SIZE:10 members comprising BA/QA&DEV

▪ ▪

▪

Analysis and documentation of business flows for multiple asset classes supported by the front office trading system. Interviews with various product owners for various systems/interfaces such as Trader System (Market Makers), DMA (Level 2 trading system), ECN/Darkpools system/interfaces, Sales Users (Sales Station), Client User (Web Platform and Mobile Platform)to find the core problem areas and recommend rationalization approaches. Involved in certification testing FIX messages, testing STP services, Give-up, Barrier monitor service, Expiry Services, Margin Calculation service etc. and functional verification ensuring no business workflows are broken

PREVIOUS ASSIGNMENTS

Ingratis|Functional Consultant - Reported to Project Manager | 2018 - 2011

Hold Brothers LLC (Trenchant Trading Systems) Senior Trader – Reported to Head of Trading | 2007 – 2008

AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS Credited with various awards like ▪ ▪ ▪

“Best Business Analyst Leader and Best BA Team Lead Award” by the MD | 2016 “Pat on the Back Award” for the FX Application -Saxo Bank| 2011 Participate in various industry conferences NASCOM, Product Leadership Forum (PLF) TeDX, IIBA, GARP.

EDUCATION

Bachelor ofCommerce in Economics and Statistics | Andhra University,Visakhapatnam
